en: The image depicts a black-and-white photograph printed on a postcard. The photo shows a serene river or canal bordered by dense trees, with several people standing or sitting in rowboats, dressed in traditional early 20th-century clothing. Some women appear to be standing or sitting on a log or boat, and a man is rowing another boat. Handwritten text in Swedish is present at the top and bottom of the image. The reverse side has Swedish text with a '5 öre' green Swedish stamp postmarked, and is addressed to a recipient in Sweden.
